2608.27343.title: Pair-Level Essay-Scale Republication and Reuse from Fragmented Historical Text Reuse: A Workflow Study on Eighteenth-Century Books and Newspapers
2608.27343.paper_summary: This paper addresses the recovery of essay-scale republication and reuse from fragmented text-reuse evidence, a setting whose central challenge is pair-level evidence consolidation and not fragment retrieval alone. The study focuses on a candidate set centered on essays by eighteenth-century Scottish philosopher David Hume, spanning books from ECCO (Eighteenth Century Collections Online) and historical newspapers. Because the input consists of fragmented reuse hits instead of clean document pairs, and positive coverage is inherently incomplete, we formulate the task as pair-level evidence consolidation into plausible transmission relations and compare three methodological families: a staged rule-based workflow, baselines (a decision tree and two direct LLM settings), and automated rule adaptation. On labeled ECCO--ECCO slices, pair-level feature aggregation alone already reaches 0.948 F1 on the main labeled slice, while the final workflow gives the strongest overall precision-recall trade-off among the tested rule stages. On the full ECCO--ECCO candidate universe, direct LLM baselines flag up to 14,886 pairs as reprints compared to 771 for the final workflow, behaving in this direct-prompt setup as high-recall candidate expanders rather than precision-controlled deployment classifiers. On ECCO--Newspaper, manual audit confirms all 176 predicted positives as genuine cases of republication or reuse, while issue duplication and source-side multiplicity reveal additional provenance structure. Under incomplete ground truth, auditable pair-level evidence consolidation provides a practical way to produce compact candidate spaces for historical inspection.
2608.27343.paper_summary_zh: 這篇論文探討了從片段文本重用證據中恢復論文規模的再出版和重用，這一情境的核心挑戰在於對配對級別證據的整合，而不僅僅是片段檢索。研究集中於以十八世紀蘇格蘭哲學家大衛·休謨的論文為中心的候選集，涵蓋了來自ECCO（十八世紀文獻在線）和歷史報紙的書籍。由於輸入由片段重用命中組成，而非乾淨的文檔對，且正面覆蓋本質上是不完整的，我們將任務表述為配對級別證據的整合，以形成合理的傳播關係，並比較三種方法論家族：分階段的基於規則的工作流程、基準（決策樹和兩個直接的LLM設置）以及自動化規則適應。在標記的ECCO--ECCO片段上，僅配對級別特徵聚合就已在主要標記片段上達到0.948的F1，而最終工作流程在測試的規則階段中提供了最強的整體精確度-召回率權衡。在完整的ECCO--ECCO候選宇宙中，直接LLM基準標記了多達14,886對作為再版，而最終工作流程則標記了771對，在這種直接提示設置中表現為高召回候選擴展器，而非精確控制的部署分類器。在ECCO--報紙上，手動審核確認所有176個預測的正例均為真正的再出版或重用案例，而問題重複和來源側的多樣性揭示了額外的來源結構。在不完整的真實情況下，可審計的配對級別證據整合提供了一種實用的方法，以產生緊湊的候選空間以供歷史檢查。
